description: This file defines an interface `IUnderlyingTransportFeature` and a class `UnderlyingConnectionTransportFeature` related to managing an underlying duplex pipe transport in a networking context within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: UnderlyingConnectionTransportFeature
classes.description: Implements `IUnderlyingTransportFeature` and provides a concrete class holding a duplex pipe transport.

methods.description: Returns the underlying duplex pipe transport.
